asset.name: Archivist Sela
asset.title: Moonlit Archivist
asset.description: A young archivist in a deep blue cloak, carrying a roll of glowing moonlit maps.
asset.personality: Cautious and curious. She records everything before she acts.
asset.motivation: Find the ancient records lost in the Moonlit Glade.

interactions.label: Ask about the Moonlit Glade
dialogue: The moonlight in this glade remembers every name.
